name: Question 5
problem:

*Hint: Use the parametrization $r(t)=(\sqrt{t}-3)\,i+t\,j.$*

Question 5
?

Which of the following is equivalent to the integral ∫CF⋅dr, where F(x,y)=2yi+x2j and C is the curve y=x+3 traversed from the point A(−3,0) to the point B(−1,4)?

Hint: Use the parametrization r(t)=(t−3)i+tj.

a
 ∫04(t−5t+9)dt
b
 ∫04(t+6t+9)dt
c
 ∫04(t+5t+3)dt
d
 ∫04(t−t+9)dt
e
 ∫04(t−4t+3)dt
